name: Interlagos
notes: Autodromo Jose Carlos Pace, Interlagos (anticlockwise). Raceway loop. Traced 4259 m vs 4309 m. Start line on the pit straight in front of the pit building. One DRS zone on the pit straight as in 2012. Values from 2012 F1: race laps, pit lane loss and overtaking are approximate. tyre_wear_mult and the wet weather multiplier are first guesses and will be tuned. speed_scale is 1.0 until the lap time calibration against the 2012 pole. pole_side is the inside of the first corner (approximate).
